title: Your first Signal Group
intro_say: MarketNavi. | Day one: your first Signal Group.
outro_say: That's your first Group. | Next, use it in a Signal Set.

steps.screen: A card: what a Group is
steps.say: A Signal Group combines a few signals into one reading, with labels you choose, such as Bullish or Bearish.
Open Lattice, then Signal Groups. | On the left is every signal you can use.
Signals come in six families, each answering one question. | Trend asks: which way is it going? | The icons filter the list.
Tap plus to add a signal. | Trend direction. | Then moving averages, choosing the fifty and two-hundred day version. | And the MACD line.
Each signal can add to the score, act as a condition, or just give context. | Here all three add to one score, from minus one hundred to plus one hundred.

steps.screen: Adding the Bullish and Bearish rules
steps.say: Rules turn the score into labels. | Bullish when the score is thirty or more. Bearish when it's minus thirty or less. | Otherwise, Neutral.
Give it a name, My Trend, and save it.
My Trend now works anywhere a Group can be used: in Signal Sets, scans and funnels.
